body: When new episodes are injested they use the incorrect cover art.  See #88 and #92 both of which I needed to manually correct.  There have to be ways to get the correct image either from the RSS feed or the YouTube api for this.  I want to redesign this part of the workflow for "Agent / Ingest Episode" so we no longer need to manually upload the thumbnail each time.

comments.body: @sepo-agent investigate this please and come up with an implementation plan.

I have everything needed. Here's my investigation and plan.

## Investigation

**Root cause:** The episode-ingest pipeline pulls cover art from the RSS feed's per-item `<itunes:image href="…">` tag ([`.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts:96`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts#L96)). But the Anchor feed sets **the same** `itunes:image` on every `<item>` — the show-level staging artwork `…/staging/podcast_uploaded_nologo/45156119/…jpg`. I fetched the live feed and confirmed all 9 items carry that identical no-logo URL. That's exactly the URL that landed in both #88 and #92 and had to be corrected by hand. **The RSS feed simply does not carry episode-specific cover art**, so no amount of parsing fixes it.

**The right source:** The site's real covers (`EP00`–`EP06` in [`quartz/static/covers/`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/main/quartz/static/covers)) are the per-episode YouTube thumbnails. The pipeline *already* resolves the episode's YouTube video via `yt-dlp` ([`matchYoutubeUrl`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts#L235), called in [`cli/episode-ingest.ts:143`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/episode-ingest.ts#L143)). YouTube exposes a deterministic thumbnail at `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<VIDEO_ID>/maxresdefault.jpg` — I verified `maxresdefault` returns HTTP 200 for episodes 5, 6, and 7. This gives us the correct, episode-specific art with no API key.

## Existing architecture

- **Deterministic core** in [`episode-ingest.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts) (pure, unit-tested via [`__tests__/episode-ingest.test.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/episode-ingest.test.ts)); **network I/O** in [`cli/episode-ingest.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/episode-ingest.ts).
- The CLI currently downloads `episode.coverUrl` to an artifact ([`downloadCover`, lines 146–150](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/episode-ingest.ts#L146-L150)) and stamps it into the issue's `**Cover Image:**` field via [`buildIssueBody`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts#L287). The [`/implement`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-episode-ingest.yml) agent then saves it to `quartz/static/covers/EPNN-cover.png`.
- Everything degrades gracefully — a missing link is reported as "not found," never a hard failure.

## Proposed approach

Derive the cover from the resolved YouTube video ID instead of the feed's `itunes:image`, preserving the pure-core / IO-shell split and graceful degradation.

## Step-by-step plan

1. **Add pure helpers** to [`episode-ingest.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts):
   - `videoIdFromYoutubeUrl(url)` → extract the `v=` id.
   - `youtubeThumbnailUrls(id)` → ordered candidates `[maxresdefault, hqdefault]` (hqdefault always exists as a fallback for brand-new uploads where maxres may lag).
2. **Wire the cover source** in [`cli/episode-ingest.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/episode-ingest.ts): after `matchYoutubeUrl`, compute the thumbnail candidates, try each with the existing `downloadCover` (checking HTTP 200), and use the first that succeeds. Pass that URL as `coverUrl` into `buildIssueBody` and the `cover_url` output.
3. **Fallback behavior:** if YouTube didn't resolve (yt-dlp blocked/absent), keep the current feed `coverUrl` only as a last resort, or mark cover "please add manually" so a human notices — decision point below.
4. **Tests:** extend [`episode-ingest.test.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/episode-ingest.test.ts) for the new helpers (id extraction, candidate ordering) and update the `buildIssueBody` cover assertion.
5. **Build & verify:** recompile `.agent` (`dist/` is committed), run `npm test`, and dispatch the workflow with `force_episode_number` to confirm the issue body now carries the YouTube thumbnail.

## One decision for you

When `yt-dlp` fails to resolve the video (it's `continue-on-error` and YouTube sometimes blocks CI runners), there's no thumbnail. Do you prefer we **(a)** fall back to the old feed art, or **(b)** leave the cover blank with a "please add manually" note so it's obvious a human must supply it? I'd lean toward **(b)** — silently reusing the wrong art is what caused this issue.

If that plan looks right, reply with **`@sepo-agent /implement`** on this issue (confirm the fallback choice) and I'll build it.
